column1: # Recorded inputs for every formula the live bobmatnyc/homebrew-trusty tap held
# on 2026-08-12, paired with the exact bytes the tap holds for it in
# scripts/test-data/homebrew/expected/<crate>.rb.
# These are OBSERVATIONS, not fixtures anyone is free to adjust: each row's
# version, tag and digests were read back out of the formula the retired inline
# generator in release.yml actually produced and pushed. That is what makes
# generate-homebrew-formula-selftest.sh a behavior-preservation test rather than
# a test of the extracted script against itself. Do not "fix" a row to make a
# failing render pass — a mismatch means the renderer drifted.
# trusty-controller is deliberately ABSENT. Its formula is a stale artifact of
# the trusty-controller -> trusty-installer rename (#1757, ADR-0013): both
# install `tctl`, and the tap's copy is three versions behind. It is being
# deleted from the tap (#5636), not reproduced here.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   crate  version  tag  binaries(space-separated)  macos_sha256  linux_sha256
# `binaries` is CRATE_CONFIG's BINARIES for that crate in release.yml, in order.
# The first entry is the formula's `test do` smoke-test target.
